reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is true that advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life. This is a trend that has both positive and negative effects on consumers and society.
Admittedly, advertisements can bring some benefits to consumers and society. First, they help people know more about different products and services. For example, advertisements on social networking platforms, websites and billboards show people many products on the market. They can see advertisements on social media, websites, television and in public places. As a result, they may always want to buy new and expensive things. reviews.question:
Some people believe that powerful advertising can be harmful to individuals.
In what ways can advertising negatively affect people?
What solutions can be implemented to minimize its harmful effects?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, many people believe that powerful advertising can be harmful to individuals in various ways. This essay will, accordingly, discuss how advertising negatively affects people and explore some effective solutions that can be implemented to minimize these harmful effects. 
On the one hand, advertising can affect people in two main negative ways. Firstly, commercials often show exaggerated images and false promises about products, which makes consumers believe the items are much better than they really are. When people buy these items and realize the truth, they often feel disappointed and lose their money. Secondly, heavy advertising leads to serious information overload. People see advertisements everywhere every day, from television and billboards to websites and social media platforms. This constant exposure creates artificial needs and pressures people into buying things they do not really need, which causes them to waste a lot of money. 
On the other hand, several solutions can be implemented by governments to minimize these negative impacts. To begin with, governments should adopt several measures such as imposing strict censorship on all advertisements. Rigorous content checks must be carried out before the release of any commercial to ensure that product descriptions accurately reflect their true quality. In addition, there should be a clear restriction on the number of platforms on which a company is permitted to market its products. This strategy will effectively protect consumers against information overload and help them avoid making unnecessary purchases. 
In conclusion, powerful advertising clearly brings negative impacts to individuals, including false expectations and unnecessary spending. However, governments can solve these problems by introducing strict censorship and limiting the platforms used for marketing.

Tuy nhiên, mở bài còn giữ gần nguyên các cụm chính của đề nên chưa thể hiện rõ cách diễn đạt lại đã học. Ở ý quá tải thông tin, em mới kể nơi xuất hiện quảng cáo rồi chuyển sang mua sắm; cần giải thích tác hại trực tiếp của việc bị quảng cáo dồn dập. Em cũng cần nói rõ hơn cách mỗi biện pháp ngăn đúng tác hại đã nêu.

reviews.question:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them.
In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits?
reviews.originalEssay:
Some people believe that video games are harmless fun or useful educational tools, while others think they have negative effects on players. In my opinion, the drawbacks of video games outweigh their benefits.

On the one hand, video games have some advantages. First, they are a good way to relax after a long day of studying or working. Players can enter a virtual world and enjoy exciting activities such as racing or fighting. This helps them feel happy and reduce stress. Second, video games can help people develop useful skills. For example, players need to think carefully and find good strategies to win. As a result, they can improve their problem-solving and decision-making skills. However, people can also develop these skills by playing sports or joining school clubs.

On the other hand, video games can cause several serious problems. The main problem is that they can be addictive. Many children spend hours playing games because they want to get higher scores or complete more levels. As a result, they may not have enough time to sleep or do their homework, which can lead to poor academic results. In addition, playing games for too long can cause health problems, such as eye strain and a lack of physical activity. Some players also spend less time with their family and friends because they prefer playing games at home.

In conclusion, although video games provide entertainment and help players develop useful skills, I believe that their disadvantages are greater than their advantages. Addiction, health problems and poor academic results are important issues that should not be ignored.

reviews.question:
It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole.
Is this a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, scientists and tourists can travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole. In my opinion, this is a positive development because it brings new experiences to tourists and helps scientists gain more knowledge.

On the one hand, travelling to remote areas can bring many benefits to tourists. Although there are many famous tourist attractions around the world, some people still want to explore new places. For example, they can visit a small island that few people know about. There, they can see rare plants and animals, try different kinds of local food and learn about the local culture. They can also take part in traditional activities and experience a different way of life. Although people can watch travel programmes on TV, visiting these places in person is more interesting and exciting.

On the other hand, travelling to remote areas is also useful for scientists. There are still many things that people do not understand about the natural world. By visiting these places, scientists can discover new viruses and learn more about climate change. For example, global warming is affecting the lives of animals in forests and deep under the sea. Scientific research can help people understand these problems and find suitable solutions. It can also help scientists protect rare animals and restore damaged natural environments. Therefore, this development can bring important benefits to both humans and nature.

In conclusion, I believe that allowing tourists and scientists to travel to remote areas is a positive development. Tourists can enjoy new experiences, while scientists can gain valuable knowledge and help protect the environment.
reviews.overall: Em đã viết đủ độ dài, giữ quan điểm có lợi và chia hai đoạn đúng cho khách du lịch và nhà khoa học. Đoạn du lịch có ví dụ rõ, nhưng ý xem trên truyền hình cần được nêu là lời phản đối của người khác rồi giải thích vì sao trải nghiệm trực tiếp hơn hẳn. Đoạn khoa học mới kể về virus và khí hậu; em cần nối các hiện tượng ấy với việc chuẩn bị ứng phó dịch bệnh trong tương lai. Cô cũng muốn em diễn đạt lại đề ở mở bài và luyện câu bị động tại chỗ phù hợp.

For example, outbreaks of new viruses occur from time to time, and global warming is affecting the lives and habitats of elusive animals in heavily wooded areas and deep under the sea. By studying these phenomena, scientists may be better prepared for future outbreaks that could kill millions of people and may find ways to restore damaged habitats. This research can also help them protect rare animals.

In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that broader access to remote natural areas is a positive development: tourists can gain new experiences, while scientists can acquire knowledge that helps them address future threats and protect the environment.

criteria.action: Diễn đạt lại hiện tượng bằng cấu trúc khác và luyện bị động ở hai chỗ tự nhiên, chẳng hạn 'rare plants and animals can be observed' và 'Research conducted in these places...'.

criteria.title: Nối câu, nối đoạn và dùng từ thay thế
evidence: On the one hand, travelling to remote areas can bring many benefits to tourists.
On the other hand, travelling to remote areas is also useful for scientists.
Therefore, this development can bring important benefits to both humans and nature.
criteria.comment: Hai đoạn đều chứng minh quan điểm có lợi, nên cặp 'On the one hand/On the other hand' khiến người đọc chờ hai mặt đối lập. 'Therefore' ở cuối đoạn khoa học cũng đến trước khi em nêu rõ lợi ích ứng phó dịch.
criteria.action: Mở đoạn đầu bằng 'To begin with' và đoạn sau bằng 'Another important benefit'; hoàn thành chuỗi khoa học trước câu chốt.

criteria.title: Viết chính xác và tự soát bài
evidence: For example, they can visit a small island that few people know about.
They can also take part in traditional activities and experience a different way of life.
criteria.comment: Các câu có chủ ngữ và động từ đầy đủ; em dùng mệnh đề 'that few people know about' đúng để bổ nghĩa cho island. Bài đủ 266 từ theo yêu cầu tối thiểu 250 từ.

studentQuotes: travelling to remote areas can bring many benefits to tourists.

outlineCoverage.requiredText: Body 1: [LỢI CHO TOURISTS]

studentQuotes: some people still want to explore new places.
they can visit a small island that few people know about.

outlineCoverage.comment: Có mong muốn khám phá, đảo ít người biết, cây/động vật hiếm, món ăn và lối sống mới. 'Traditional activities' chưa nêu rõ tập quán tín ngưỡng bản địa theo ví dụ được giao.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: - no matter how many tourist attractions there are in the world - globetrotters all around the world still crave novelty → [ex] travel to an island that is unknown to the vast majority of people → travelers - have a chance to participate in exotic religious practices of indigenous people + feast their eyes on rarely seen plants and animals + try new food and experience a whole new way of life

studentQuotes: Although people can watch travel programmes on TV, visiting these places in person is more interesting and exciting.
outlineCoverage.comment: Có đối chiếu xem trên màn hình với đi trực tiếp, nhưng thiếu lời dẫn cho thấy đây là ý của người khác và chưa giải thích rõ sự thua kém của trải nghiệm gián tiếp.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → [phản biện nhỏ để kéo dài đoạn - tránh bí ý thiếu từ và tạo điểm nhấn tư duy cho bài luận] Granted, one might say that they can see these things on TV channels dedicated to travel. However, the experience is far inferior to experiencing such activities in person.

studentQuotes: travelling to remote areas is also useful for scientists.
outlineCoverage.comment: Câu mở đoạn nêu đúng lợi ích cho nhà khoa học.

studentQuotes: There are still many things that people do not understand about the natural world.
By visiting these places, scientists can discover new viruses and learn more about climate change.
outlineCoverage.comment: Nêu được khoảng trống hiểu biết và việc đến vùng xa; cần diễn đạt thận trọng hơn cách nghiên cứu ở đó có thể giúp tìm lời giải cho vấn đề hiện tại hoặc tương lai.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → regardless of how much we already know about the world - there is still much that is unknown in the field of science → visit such places - give scientists answers to many existing and future problems

studentQuotes: global warming is affecting the lives of animals in forests and deep under the sea.

outlineCoverage.comment: Có ví dụ nóng lên toàn cầu và hướng bảo vệ/phục hồi. Em chưa nêu các đợt bùng phát virus mới theo thời gian và kết quả chuẩn bị ứng phó dịch bệnh tiềm ẩn.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → [ex] see this in the way novel viruses break out every once in a while, and how global warming is affecting lives and habitats of elusive animals in heavily wooded areas and deep under the sea → understand more about such phenomena - far more prepared for potential outbreaks - kill millions in the future + help restore damaged habitats
